```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(corrplot)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#data("penguins")


FRED_MD <- read_csv("2026-10-MD.csv")

# Remove rows containing metadata
macro <- FRED_MD %>%
  slice(-1) %>%
  mutate(sasdate = as.Date(sasdate, format = "%m/%d/%Y"))
```

```{r}
# Visualization of variables over time 
macro %>%
  select(sasdate, INDPRO, UNRATE, CPIAUCSL, HOUST) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -sasdate,
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(sasdate, value)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Evolution of Selected U.S. Economic Indicators",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Value"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
#FRED-MD transformation function
transform_variable <- function(x, code) {

  if (code == 1) {
    return(x)
  }

  if (code == 2) {
    return(c(NA, diff(x)))
  }

  if (code == 4) {
    return(log(x))
  }

  if (code == 5) {
    return(c(NA, diff(log(x))))
  }

  if (code == 6) {
    return(c(NA, NA, diff(log(x), differences = 2)))
  }

  if (code == 7) {
    growth <- c(NA, diff(x) / head(x, -1))
    return(c(NA, diff(growth)))
  }
}
```

```{r}
#Apply transformations
X_transformed <- as.data.frame(
  Map(
    transform_variable,
    X_raw,
    transform_codes
  )
)

names(X_transformed) <- names(X_raw)

dim(X_transformed)
```

```{r}
FRED_MD %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  select(sasdate, INDPRO, UNRATE, CPIAUCSL, HOUST)
```

```{r}
# Visualize trends with recommended transformations applied
macro_transformed <- macro %>%
  mutate(
    INDPRO = c(NA, diff(log(INDPRO))),
    UNRATE = c(NA, diff(UNRATE)),
    CPIAUCSL = c(NA, NA, diff(log(CPIAUCSL), differences = 2)),
    HOUST = log(HOUST)
  )

macro_transformed %>%
  select(sasdate, INDPRO, UNRATE, CPIAUCSL, HOUST) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -sasdate,
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(sasdate, value)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Transformed Economic Indicators",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Transformed value"
  )
```

```{r}
# Create the correlation matrix
cor_data <- macro_transformed %>%
  select(INDPRO, UNRATE, CPIAUCSL, HOUST)

cor_matrix <- cor(
  cor_data,
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)

round(cor_matrix, 3)
```

```{r}
# Visualize the correlation matrix
corrplot(
  cor_matrix,
  method = "color",
  type = "upper",
  addCoef.col = "black",
  tl.col = "black",
  tl.srt = 45
)
```

```{r}
# Extract transformation codes
transform_codes <- FRED_MD %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  select(-sasdate) %>%
  unlist() %>%
  as.numeric()

names(transform_codes) <- names(macro)[-1]
```

```{r}
macro_transformed <- as.data.frame(
  Map(
    transform_variable,
    macro %>% select(-sasdate),
    transform_codes
  )
)

names(macro_transformed) <- names(macro)[-1]

macro_transformed$sasdate <- macro$sasdate
```

```{r}
# Observe missing values
missing_summary <- macro_transformed %>%
  select(-sasdate) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "missing"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(missing))

head(missing_summary, 15)
```

```{r}
# Observe where missing values are
macro_transformed %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      c(ACOGNO, UMCSENTx, TWEXAFEGSMTHx,
        ANDENOx, VIXCLSx, PERMIT),
      ~which(is.na(.))[1],
      .names = "{.col}_first_missing"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
macro_transformed %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      c(ACOGNO, UMCSENTx, TWEXAFEGSMTHx,
        ANDENOx, VIXCLSx, PERMIT),
      ~which(!is.na(.))[1],
      .names = "{.col}_first_available"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
pca_data <- macro_transformed %>%
  select(-sasdate, -ACOGNO, -UMCSENTx, -TWEXAFEGSMTHx) %>%
  filter(if_all(everything(), ~ !is.na(.)))
```

```{r}
pca_scaled <- scale(pca_data)

mean(pca_scaled[,1])
sd(pca_scaled[,1])
```
```{r}
pca_result <- prcomp(
  pca_scaled,
  center = FALSE,
  scale. = FALSE
)

summary(pca_result)
```

```{r}
scree_data <- data.frame(
  PC = 1:length(pca_result$sdev),
  Eigenvalue = pca_result$sdev^2
)

ggplot(scree_data, aes(x = PC, y = Eigenvalue)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "PCA Scree Plot",
    x = "Principal Component",
    y = "Eigenvalue"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
eigenvalues <- pca_result$sdev^2

sum(eigenvalues > 1)

which(cumsum(pca_result$sdev^2 /
               sum(pca_result$sdev^2)) >= 0.70)[1]
```

```{r}
loadings <- as.data.frame(
  pca_result$rotation[, 1:9]
)

loadings$variable <- rownames(loadings)
```

```{r}
loadings %>%
```
